In addition to the pay raise and seven days of sick leave for American rail workers, I am proud to have voted with fellow @HouseDemocrats to avert a rail shutdown. 

The dignity of a fair wage and the right to receive medical treatment should be guaranteed to everyone https://t.co/nuxWoJZnIX

Cancer touches us all.
 
Cancer education, prevention, treatment, and care should be accessible to everyone, regardless of their income, ethnicity, or gender.
 
On #WorldCancerDay, I'm spreading the word to #CloseTheCareGap.

Do you know how to spot a stroke? 

By learning the warning signs and symptoms, you may be able to save someone's life. Visit https://t.co/xBLe5wCdNl to learn more. 

#StrokeMonth https://t.co/3CeJf3a0HK

As a Member of the @EqualityCaucus, I encourage everyone to know their status & get tested for HIV.

We must end the stigma, ensure access to preventative medicines for those at risk of contracting HIV, & improve access to testing & treatment.

Learn more: https://t.co/jGLraMpMD2

Instead of complaining about a "two-tiered justice system" investigating disproven Biden allegations, @GOPoversight should look at a real two-tiered system: unfair treatment of people of color. https://t.co/B7B1NL6vyL

Proud to join @RepEmiliaSykes and colleagues from both parties to mark #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth and show support for those impacted by this disease. It is imperative that we support treatment and care for patients and further research, including the Cancer Moonshot.

Proud to announce the #UFIGHT Act, legislation to authorize federal grants for early detection, treatment, and research on uterine fibroids. Excited to have 50 cosponsors as well as Ohio and national women’s health organizations supporting the bill. https://t.co/k4Rdraoo8A

On Thursday, I was joined by colleagues and advocates to announce the #UFIGHT Act. Millions of women endure severe fibroid symptoms, which disproportionally impact Black women. My #UFIGHT Act authorizes federal grants for early detection, treatment, & research – it’s needed. https://t.co/YcJ9wcTMlJ

For too long, women have suffered due to fibroids, without adequate access to early detection or treatment. My new legislation, the #UFIGHT Act changes that, authorizing a new federal grant program.
If you fight fibroids, I’m fighting with you. https://t.co/aGRjscMHMP

Proud to announce that we're now up to 57 cosponsors for the #UFIGHTAct - my legislation to launch a federal program to promote early detection, treatment, and research on uterine fibroids. #FibroidAwarenessMonth

July is #FibroidAwarenessMonth. Most women experience fibroids and for some, the symptoms are benign. But for millions of others, including me, fibroids are not benign. Recently, I shared #MyFibroidStory when introducing the #UFightAct. Let’s break the silence around fibroids. https://t.co/hHtwDKEvm6

July is #FibroidAwarenessMonth, a time to highlight the prevalence of uterine fibroids and the need for detection, treatment, and research. Let's spread the word and speak out. Share your fibroid story with #MyFibroidStory https://t.co/31Da1fTJA3

A heart attack happens every 40 seconds in the U.S. Many are silent, without major symptoms. Awareness and prevention are key to changing this alarming statistic. #CBCCholesterolAwareness https://t.co/jsykwDxfkI

We had a bipartisan deal. 

But Trump and Elon threw a fit. 

What’s in: a two-year free pass for Trump’s giveaways to the rich.

What’s out: funding for SNAP, lower drug costs, medical research and treatment. 

Ohioans lose and President Musk and his Vice President Trump win.

House Democrats have a clear message: hands off Medicaid and SNAP. That’s why we are trying to force a vote in the House to protect health care and nutrition benefits from Republican cuts. It’s time for House Republicans to put up or shut up.

🧵3/8 Who gets hit the hardest?

5 million seniors relying on food assistance to make ends meet

10 million children whose health and development depend on consistent nutrition

Millions of veterans and people with disabilities

🧵6/8 This bill discards 90% of the traditional farm bill to push a partisan agenda.

That includes gutting the nutrition title—an essential pillar of both rural and urban economies.

Trump's Big Ugly Bill includes devastating cuts to Medicaid and SNAP that would cause millions to lose their health care and nutrition assistance. 

Today I stood with @RepPressley, @RepSummerLee and @RepAdams and advocates from across the country to fight back. https://t.co/8BFZmjbb1D

If Trump's Big Ugly Bill becomes law, millions are at risk of losing basic nutrition benefits. That includes Cheryl from Cleveland Heights, who is caring for her disabled husband and disabled father. 

I will keep speaking for them. https://t.co/YZh6mQepps

In a few minutes we will vote on Trump's Big Ugly Bill. 

If this bill becomes law, hundreds of thousands of Ohioans will lose their health care and lose their nutrition benefits - at a time when prices keep going up. 

That's a Hell No for me.

Cutting basic nutrition benefits to give tax cuts to the wealthy - this is beyond wrong.

The Big Ugly Bill is now in the Senate. We're going to keep fighting.

https://t.co/VXx0ydPutB

Under Trump's Big Ugly Bill hundreds of thousands of Ohioans will lose health care and basic nutrition benefits - all to enrich those at the top. 

I won't stop fighting, because my constituents can't afford this scam. https://t.co/WhZq3gpAjK
📺 At 2:10 PM I'll join @AlexWitt on @MSNBC to talk about what Trump's cruel cuts to SNAP nutrition benefits will mean for families, Elon, and DOGE.  Tune in! 📺

House Republicans passed the Big Ugly Bill in the dead of night, then spent two weeks trying to spin and swindle the American people about what was in it.

The reality: millions will lose health care and millions will lose nutrition benefits - for tax cuts for the rich.

The treatment of Sen. Padilla is unacceptable.

A sitting U.S. Senator thrown to the ground, handcuffed, and detained for speaking out? This isn’t normal. The administration’s pattern of targeting members of Congress and anyone who questions them is authoritarian.

We cannot let this stand.
